newsitem.title: USA: NGC sees Q3 excluding charge within estimate.
newsitem.headline: NGC sees Q3 excluding charge within estimate.

text.p: NGC Corp said Wednesday it will record a third quarter charge of about $2.5 million after-tax, or $0.02 per share.
The company said excluding the charge, it expects results to fall "well within analysts' expectations."

The charge principally reflects the difference between leasing costs for the company's headquarters and the anticipated revenue from subletting the space after NGC relocates in the first quarter of 1997, the company said.
First Call third quarter estimate for the company is $0.15 per share and listed earnings for the year-ago period at $0.13 per share.
